question.name: CSEC IT May 2025 Q1c — Why Choose Laser Over Inkjet?
question.text:
A musician is in the process of sourcing a printer. Provide THREE reasons why a laser printer should be chosen over an inkjet printer by dragging the correct reasons into the blanks below.

Reason 1: [[1]]

Reason 2: [[2]]

Reason 3: [[3]]
question.general_feedback:
Advantages of laser over inkjet:

  1. Faster printing speed — laser printers print significantly more pages per minute than inkjet printers, important for high-volume printing.
  2. Lower cost per page — toner cartridges last longer and produce more pages than ink cartridges, reducing per-page cost over time.
  3. Higher quality text output — laser printers produce sharper, crisper text using a dry powder (toner) process, whereas inkjet ink can bleed or smear.

Inkjet distractors to avoid: Inkjet printers are better for photo-quality color printing (not laser); inkjet ink smears more easily; inkjet printers have higher per-page costs for heavy use.

ddwtos.word_bank_note: 5 tokens for 3 slots; 3 correct + 2 distractors. Distractors: 'Better at printing high-quality color photographs' — this is actually an INKJET advantage (not laser), so it's a plausible wrong choice. 'Ink smears easily after printing' — this describes an inkjet DISADVANTAGE but is not a laser ADVANTAGE per se. Students who choose it are describing the wrong device. The 3 correct reasons reflect standard CSEC IT marking scheme responses.
